title: Specified integral point-power compositor
statement: For the specified point Frobenius $h$ and integral derived-complete constructible $N$ of [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport], a normalized integral comparison family $B$ of [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization], and $m\geq0$, define $c^E_{m,N}:L(h^{m+1})^*N\xrightarrow{\sim}Lh^*L(h^m)^*N$ to be the comparison in $B$ for $h$ followed by $h^m$, preceded by the scheme-map equality $h^{m+1}=h\circ h^m$. Retain $m=0$ and the specified unit normalization.
